name: polyrefine
description: A structured translation and refinement workflow that preserves meaning.

interface.longDescription: PolyRefine Translator runs a repeatable refinement and translation workflow rather than a one-off translation. Semantic Lock checks who did what, when, and with what certainty or obligation, and checks that identifiers survive unchanged. Materially ambiguous pronouns get separate, labeled interpretations instead of a guessed subject. Rewrite detection distinguishes new text from a requested edit and regenerates only the applicable languages from the revised source. A fixed output contract gives you copy-ready English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese for English and Vietnamese input, or English for reverse translation, unless you request another target.
